decks.notes: This deck is focused on utilizing graveyard recursion and sacrificing creatures to create explosive combos. Cards like Dread Return, Exhume, and Malevolent Rumble help bring back key creatures from the graveyard, while cards like Commune with Nature and Lead the Stampede help dig for combo pieces. The deck also includes various creatures with powerful abilities that can be sacrificed for value, such as Masked Vandal and Mesmeric Fiend. By assembling the right combination of cards, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with a lethal board state.

The main concept of this Aggro-Affinity deck is to quickly deploy artifact creatures and utilize artifact synergy to overwhelm the opponent. By sacrificing artifacts like Ichor Wellspring and Myr Enforcer to effects like Fanatical Offering and Makeshift Munitions, the deck can deal damage directly to the opponent or control the board with cards like Krark-Clan Shaman. Thoughtcast and Reckoner's Bargain provide card draw to maintain momentum, while the mana base allows for efficient casting of spells. Additionally, Nihil Spellbomb provides graveyard hate against opposing strategies that rely on recursion.

This deck focuses on quickly establishing a board presence with small, evasive creatures like Faerie Miscreant and Ninja of the Deep Hours, while disrupting opponents with counterspells like Spell Pierce and Counterspell. The goal is to maintain control of the game through tempo plays and card advantage, utilizing bounce effects like Snap and Brinebarrow Intruder to control the battlefield. The deck aims to win by chipping away at the opponent's life total with efficient creatures and finishing the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main objective of this deck is to stall the game using cards like Darkness, Moment's Peace, and Tangle to prevent the opponent from attacking while constantly drawing cards and gaining life with cards like Ichor Wellspring and Weather the Storm. When the time is right, the player can dig for combo pieces like Reckoner's Bargain and Fanatical Offering to win the game in one explosive turn. The deck utilizes a mix of fog effects, card draw, and combo pieces to control the game until it can assemble its win condition.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage, while using evasion and card advantage to win the game. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce, removal like Snuff Out and Cast Down, and card advantage cards like Deep Analysis and Brainstorm. It also utilizes evasive creatures like Spellstutter Sprite and Gurmag Angler to apply pressure and win the game. The deck's mana base supports its control strategy with a mix of Islands and Swamps.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a strong and fast army of Elves. By utilizing mana accelerants like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, along with cards like Priest of Titania, this deck aims to quickly ramp up and generate a large amount of mana to cast powerful creatures like Nyxborn Hydra and Timberwatch Elf. Lead the Stampede and Winding Way help refill the hand with more Elves, ensuring a steady stream of threats to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory through sheer numbers and aggression.

The main focus of this Mono Green Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of creatures and pump spells. By using cards like Sprout, Saproling Migration, and Scatter the Seeds, the deck aims to flood the board with tokens and then buff them with spells like Might of the Masses and Echoing Courage. The goal is to deal damage quickly and efficiently, utilizing the synergy between token generation and pump spells to outpace the opponent and secure a swift victory.

This deck focuses on assembling the Urzatron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, and Urza's Tower) to generate a large amount of mana. It utilizes various artifacts to control the board and generate value, such as Ashnod's Altar, Golem Foundry, and Ichor Wellspring. The deck also includes cards like Fanatical Offering and Pactdoll Terror for removal and interaction with opponents' creatures. The main goal is to control the game until the Urzatron lands are assembled, allowing for powerful plays and overwhelming the opponent with superior resources.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of Gates and powerful control spells. By using Gates to ramp up mana and fix colors, the deck can quickly establish control of the battlefield. Lórien Revealed acts as a win condition by creating card advantage, while cards like Counterspell and Journey to Nowhere help maintain control. The deck also includes ways to protect itself with Prismatic Strands and Dispel. Overall, the strategy is to outlast opponents and seize victory through strategic decision-making and efficient resource management.

This deck focuses on using walls to generate mana and then combo off with cards like Freed from the Real and Galvanic Alchemist to create infinite mana loops. The main goal is to tutor for combo pieces and control the board until the combo can be assembled. The walls provide defense while also enabling the combo to go off. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its mana generation and combo potential, leveraging the synergy between its creatures and spells to win the game efficiently.

The main concept of this deck is to control the opponent's actions and disrupt their game plan using counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. By efficiently managing resources and utilizing powerful creatures like Murmuring Mystic and Augur of Bolas, this UR Control deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent until it can secure victory through a combination of tempo advantage and card advantage. The inclusion of burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Skred provides additional removal options and reach to close out games.

The main focus of this Mono Black Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of low-cost creatures and sacrifice effects. By using cards like Carrion Feeder and Bloodthrone Vampire to sacrifice creatures, along with Village Rites for card draw and Supernatural Stamina for additional protection, the deck aims to continuously build up its board presence while draining the opponent's life total. With a combination of aggressive creatures and sacrifice synergies, the deck seeks to outpace the opponent and secure a victory through relentless pressure.

This mono blue aggro deck focuses on utilizing low-cost creatures with disruptive abilities, such as Spellstutter Sprite and Brinebarrow Intruder, to quickly apply pressure to the opponent. The deck also includes card draw and counterspells to maintain tempo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Moon-Circuit Hacker provides additional card advantage, while Ninja of the Deep Hours allows for additional card draw via its ninjutsu ability. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and disruption while maintaining card advantage to secure victory.

The main concept of this Mono Blue Aggro deck is to quickly deploy low-cost aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Cryptic Serpent, while using card draw and card selection spells like Brainstorm and Thought Scour to maintain hand advantage. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Spell Pierce and Counterspell to protect its creatures and slow down the opponent's game plan. Boomerang offers additional tempo plays, bouncing problematic permanents back to the opponent's hand. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure, disrupt the opponent's strategy, and finish the game quickly.

This Mono Blue Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with cheap and efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Cryptic Serpent. By combining card draw and counter spells to maintain tempo, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while constantly applying pressure. Thought Scour, Mental Note, and Brainstorm help dig for key pieces, while Tolarian Terror can be used for removal. Lórien Revealed boosts the power of the aggro creatures, making them even more threatening. This deck is built for fast-paced gameplay and aggressive strategies.

The main concept of this Aggro - Affinity Pauper deck is to quickly establish a board presence with cheap artifacts and utilize sacrifice effects to deal direct damage to the opponent. By sacrificing artifacts like Refurbished Familiar, Ichor Wellspring, and Myr Enforcer to cards like Makeshift Munitions and Fanatical Offering, the deck aims to create a fast and efficient way to close out the game. The inclusion of cards like Galvanic Blast and Krark-Clan Shaman further enhances the deck's aggressive strategy, while Thoughtcast provides card advantage to keep the pressure on the opponent.
